a_plateau.note: not a ledger quantity: the plateau rule reads I_d, N_e and n_g drifts, the triad soft bounds and the peak-Debye soft margin
a_plateau.rule: stop_reason == plateau_reached_after_min_transit_times under the rule above (>= 3 transits, trailing-20 % drifts of I_d, N_e, n_g < 5 %, triad soft bounds, peak-Debye soft margin 2.5)

b_residual_power.basis: corrected statistic (the recorded statistic is kept beside it; the bound is NOT loosened)

corrected.statistic: ledger-corrected.json end_state_window.corrected_ratio = H / electrode work over the trailing window, H = field work + dU - electrode work

b_residual_power.rule: summary.grid_heating_triad.windowed_energy_residual_over_electrode_work (the trailing 400000-step ratio at the stop) < +0.02 (heating side, one-sided; the accepted 50 um runs read -0.2 % / -1.5 % / -4.2 % - the negative side is reported, not judged) - i.e. the refined run is itself free of grid heating at the 2 % level

c_convergence.note: not a ledger quantity: the (c) tolerances compare plateau quantities; the reference's own corrected reading is reported below

reference_corrected_ledger.reading: the 50 um base plateau reads +13.0 % of the electrode work on the corrected ledger (recorded +0.4 %): it was heating numerically; the v2.0.3 5 % gate would have stopped it at 2.70 us

c_convergence.rule: relative |v4 - v2| / |v2| on the trailing-20 % / window quantities (I_d, I_beam: summary.window_currents_a; S, utilisation, n_g: summary.neutral_inventory trailing means; peak n_e and T_e,peak: the window maps at the densest node); tolerances = 2x the particle-resolution band of the 50 um convergence pair (I_d 5.7 %, S 4.6 %, n_g 4.0 %, peak n_e 11.9 %, T_e,peak 9.3 %); the refinement changes W with the grid (fixed particles per cell), so grid and particle effects are entangled at the 5 % level - a W-only variant at 50 um (W = 2.667e4) is the declared follow-up if (c) fails

claim_boundary: preregistered grid-refinement (33.3 um / 1.4 ps / W 2.667e4) check of the development PIC-MCC steady-state plateau of pic2d_cft_steady_state_v2 under the same v1.3 closure and operating point; the outcome classifies the 50 um plateau as resolution-converged or resolution-limited at the predeclared tolerances; not validated against experiment; not a thruster performance prediction; the neutral transient is artificial and only the fixed point is physical

d_reclassification.corrected_text: (a) but NOT (b) -> the 33 um run itself heats above 2 % of the electrode work: the comparison is not a convergence test; the peak-Debye reading and residual are reported and a finer grid or lower operating point is the follow-up
d_reclassification.mapping: the predeclared (d) outcome tree of run.py assess applied with (b) on the corrected statistic; (a) and (c) as recorded
d_reclassification.recorded_text: (a) AND (b) but at least one (c) tolerance exceeded -> the 50 um base plateau is 'RESOLUTION-LIMITED': the v4 values supersede the v2 values for the quantities that moved, and the v2 plateau (Delta/lambda_D 3.17, on the CIC threshold) is recorded as under-resolved - a valid recorded outcome
d_reclassification.what_stands: the recorded verdict stands as the recorded outcome of the preregistered execution; the 50 um base's classification as resolution-limited is not rescued by the re-read (the base reads +13.0 % on the corrected ledger, more than the 33 um run); what changes is that the 33 um plateau carries its own numerical heating power above the predeclared 2 % bound and may not be called a clean (energy-conserving) reference

disallowed_wording: converged (for 33 um or 50 um) before the 25 um ladder point reports
any residual value recorded before v2.0.6 without the corrected value next to it
model_version_note: pic2d model v2.0.6 energy-ledger correction (inelastic_loss_j lacked the macro weight W up to v2.0.5) applied post hoc through the ledger-corrected.json sidecar; the recorded series, summary, maps and assessment.json are unchanged

recorded.d_reclassification: (a) AND (b) but at least one (c) tolerance exceeded -> the 50 um base plateau is 'RESOLUTION-LIMITED': the v4 values supersede the v2 values for the quantities that moved, and the v2 plateau (Delta/lambda_D 3.17, on the CIC threshold) is recorded as under-resolved - a valid recorded outcome

verdict_statement: plateau reached; convergence vs 50 µm as recorded (resolution_limited for 50 µm); residual precondition (b) FAILED on the corrected ledger → the 33 µm plateau is itself heating at +2.5 % of electrode work and is NOT a clean reference; 25 µm (v5) pending
